# opstracer_member_title (Resource)

A custom member title for the org, alongside the built-in ones (Engineer, Manager, ...).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opstracer_member_title" "sre" {
  name = "SRE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Title shown on members.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Title ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_member_title.sre <member-title-id>
```
